title: Director of Customer Growth & Integrated Campaigns
description_html:
Local candidates only. This role is hybrid in our Chicago, Illinois office.
What You Will Be Doing
Campaign Strategy & Ownership
  • Own the full end‑to‑end expansion campaign framework for selling Cloud add‑on products and modules to existing Cleo customers.
  • Translate company growth priorities and product add‑ons into clear, repeatable customer campaign plans.
  • Lead cross‑functional contributors across Product, Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, and Marketing.
  • Define customer campaign objectives, success metrics, timelines, and key dependencies.
  • Identify and communicate hurdles impacting progress, and act as the single point of accountability for campaign execution and outcomes.

Customer Targeting & Use‑Case Definition
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to identify high‑propensity customer segments for Cloud Add‑on campaigns.
  • Define customer expansion triggers such as usage patterns, maturity, integration needs, compliance requirements, or supply‑chain complexity.
  • Build persona‑specific value propositions for IT, supply chain, and operations leaders.
  • Ensure campaigns are anchored in real customer pain points and buying moments - not theoretical use cases.

Messaging, Positioning & Enablement
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing to develop customer campaign messaging, narratives, and proof points.
  • Work with Marketing to align positioning across email, in‑app assets, website content, webinars, demo videos, and supporting materials.
  • Partner with Sales Enablement and Solutions to deliver demos, solution walkthroughs, and technical validation assets.
  • Equip Sales and CSMs with the right talk tracks, decks, FAQs, and resources.

Cross‑Functional Orchestration & Project Management
  • Serve as the orchestrator across teams, ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely execution.
  • Lead weekly execution meetings, standups, and retrospectives.
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies across marketing motions, sales motions, CS outreach, and product/solutions participation.
  • Proactively remove blockers and escalate to executive leadership when needed.

Promotion & Channel Coordination
  • Coordinate multi‑channel promotion plans with Marketing, including lifecycle/email, in‑app messaging, sales‑led outreach, and webinar/event promotion.
  • Ensure campaigns are cohesive and consistent across all customer touchpoints.

Measurement, Insights & Optimization
  • Partner with the CMO and CRO to define KPIs and campaign targets.
  • Track leading and lagging campaign metrics, including engaged accounts, qualified opportunities, pipeline creation, campaign conversion, and ACV bookings.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Ops and Revenue leaders to build dashboards and analyze performance.
  • Use data to continually refine targeting, messaging, and campaign structure - creating a closed feedback loop with all stakeholders.

Your Skills
  • Revenue Mindset: Focused on pipeline, bookings, and ARR-not just top‑of‑funnel metrics.
  • Strong Operator: Brings structure, cadence, and discipline to cross‑functional execution.
  • Cross‑Functional Leader: Influences without authority across Product, Sales, CS, and Marketing.
  • High Bar for Execution: Drives campaigns to completion, not just kickoff.
  • Strategic + Tactical: Can zoom out to portfolio strategy while also digging into execution details.
  • Executive Presence: Able to confidently present to C‑level leaders and senior executives.
  • Customer Marketing: Ability to create creative approaches for engaging customers for public advocacy and expansion purposes

Your Qualifications
Education
  • Bachelor's degree required.

Experience
  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, revenue programs, or GTM roles.
  • 3+ years leading managers or team leads.
  • Demonstrated ownership of pipeline, revenue impact, and expansion‑focused campaign outcomes.
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales, CS, Product, and Solutions teams.
  • Experience working with solutions engineering or professional services teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce CRM, marketing platforms (6Sense, SalesLoft), lifecycle tools, and AI‑enabled systems.
  • Proven project management ability and influence without authority.
  • Strong communication, organization, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Experience with usage‑based expansion models, product‑led signals, or lifecycle marketing.
  • Comfortable with CRM, automation, and analytics platforms.

A few things we have to offer:
  • Compensation: $120,000 - $140,000 + Bonus potential
  • Great Healthcare + Dental + Vision
  • Flexible PTO
  • Culture of support, encouraging Life-Work balance
  • 401k match
  • FSA and HSA options
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Representing a company with 4,000+ clients and a 99% retention rate
  • Accelerated title and salary growth potential
  • A fun and energetic work environment that makes you excited to go to work every day

description_html:
What You Will Be Doing
  • Uphold Cleo's Customer Success strategy and processes, ensuring that 100% of interactions are accurately recorded and follow-ups are scheduled.
  • Oversee the customer lifecycle, from launch to renewal, to ensure a seamless and optimal customer journey.
  • Manage a customer base of 30+ customers , including regular 1-on-1s with key stakeholders and quarterly Executive Business Reviews.
  • Develop broad and deep customer relationships, promoting strong customer loyalty & highly referenceable customers.
  • Understand our customers' organizational structure and develop relationships with key business stakeholders.

  • Maintain accurate records, including detailed documentation of customer service actions and discussions .

title: Director of Go-To-Market Enablement
description_html:
Agora is a leading SaaS and FinTech platform transforming how real estate investment firms manage their capital, investors, and operations. Trusted by 1000+ GPs, owners/operators, and investment firms globally, we help teams streamline the full lifecycle of investment management—from fundraising and onboarding to reporting, distributions, tax, and back-office automation.

But we’re more than just software. We’re a team of bold thinkers, innovators, and real estate enthusiasts who believe complex processes should feel simple. Our platform combines modern technology with expert services, helping our customers raise more capital, deliver a better investor experience, and scale their businesses smarter.

Agora is backed by top-tier VCs like Insight Partners and Qumra Capital, and we’re growing fast. We’ve been named one of Globes’ Most Promising Startups, recognized as a Best Start-Up Companies to Work For by Duns 100, and one of Business Insider’s Hottest PropTech Startups. 

About the Role

We are seeking a Director of Go-to-Market Enablement to build and lead our GTM Enablement function. This strategic, hands-on role, based in New York City, is responsible for increasing the productivity, effectiveness, and consistency of our revenue-generating teams including SDRs, Account Executives, and Customer Success across the full Go-to-Market funnel.

The Director will combine strategic thinking with practical execution, analyzing performance, identifying gaps, building enablement frameworks, and ensuring teams are equipped to perform at scale in a high-volume SMB sales environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who can hit the ground running, owning and executing enablement initiatives from day one while quickly diagnosing what’s working and what’s not. Over time, this leader will build, manage, and scale a small enablement team. The role reports directly to the CRO/CEO and works closely with RevOps, Sales Leadership, Product Marketing, and Customer Success.

  • Proven experience in Go-to-Market, Revenue, or Sales Enablement
  • Proven experience managing a small team of Sales and CS enablement
  • Strong understanding of SDR motions, SMB sales, and AE workflows
  • Hands-on experience building enablement programs, playbooks, and training frameworks for Sales and Customer Success within a B2B SaaS product
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with performance data and metrics
  • Experience partnering with RevOps, Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations and Product
  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives without formal authority
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, enablement platforms, and BI tools
  • Experience in a fast-growing SaaS company (preferred)
  • Experience building a new function or capability from scratch (preferred)
  • Excellent communication skills in English

Compensation: $200k+ Compensation is flexible and based on experience, with additional upside potential.

title: Founding Engineer
description_html:
About the role

Superposition is the AI headhunter for startups. We are hiring our first employee. As our founding engineer you will take outsized ownership over entire products from scratch.

We have early traction for an agent that actually gets work done. We're tackling an absurdly large and broken market. Apply for our job and help us fix recruitment so that no-one ever has to apply for a job again.

What you’ll do

  • Run multiple coding agents in parallel to ship delightful interfaces rapidly
  • Use your knowledge of Typescript to review PRs from multiple agents and build scaffolding to improve their output
  • Build robust infrastructure for domains that agents can't yet handle, integrating with a wide range of 3rd party systems
  • Talk directly to customers, and push daily

What we’re looking for

  • You are super agent-pilled - you build (with) agents by default, are a macro-optimist about AI’s future capabilities and a micro-pessimist about the limitations today. You’ve got opinions about context engineering, memory and evals that are derived from hands on building not just reading Arvix.
  • You prefer the pursuit of a singularly ambitious goal over incremental improvements to the status quo. We are not building a tool for recruiters, we are building an agent that outperforms all current human recruiters combined. We are obsessed with solving the whole problem not pieces of it.
  • You’re curious - you believe rate of learning is what helps startups succeed in the 0→1 phase, not mindless thrash. We will win by having the highest fidelity mental model of our customers’ pain points.
  • You’re high agency - you work without being told what to work on, pull on threads proactively and get frustrated when limited to very narrow parameters. Your agency and urgency pushes the company forward.
  • You think from first principles - you reason over problems, avoid “happy ears” and don’t just replicate the status quo in code.
  • You’re a futurist who is genuinely excited about seeing the brain computer interface, quantum computing, space exploration and androids in our lifetime.
  • You are uniquely intense - you have a hobby that you do better than some professionals. Edmund will talk at you about the physics of pourover coffee, and Li is an interior designer at heart. We look forward to hearing you talk enthusiastically about your weird thing.

Why join us

  • work in-person out of the most curated and highly aesthetic startup hub in NYC (Betaworks). You’ll bump into the founders of FourSquare, teams building androids and hats that read your mind.
  • join a team with domain taste. Edmund did the job we are replacing, and has earned insights into why recruitment is broken. We have the highest taste evals out there.
  • take a massive swing at a market that will be insanely competitive and winner takes most, making Deel vs Rippling seem tame
  • stay an absurdly lean team of builders. We are building the most talent dense, high leverage expedition crew. You will have all resources you need to do the best work of your life. We will never hire managers.
  • build for builders. We're becoming the defacto way startups hire, you'll talk to founders of future unicorns to build the product that helps them hire better matched talent

Benefits

  • Premium health, vision and dental - platinum plan for you, your spouse and kids
  • Life insurance
  • Untracked PTO - we’re adults, take time when you need it, we’re not counting
  • Unlimited Transportation budget
  • Paid gym membership & trainer once a week
  • Cleaner & laundry service
  • All meals at the office covered
  • Angel check when you start your own startup

Interview Process

  1. Intro call with Edmund (30 minutes)
  2. Technical call with Li (30 minutes though likely to run over if you both start geeking out)
  3. Technical assessment - work on this async or come spend a day building in person with us
  4. Technical Debrief with Li (60 minutes, in-person) - talk through what you built
  5. Culture with Edmund (60 minutes, in-person) - why you should / shouldn’t work here
  6. Offer

If you prefer, we can roll steps 3, 4 and 5 together into one super day

About Superposition

We are building the AI headhunter for startups.

Recruitment is one of the few domains where we can build agents that improve the quality of the outcome, not just do things cheaper and faster than the status quo

Recruitment agencies charge US companies $200B a year but have an NPS worse than healthcare.

We are going to maximize the number of people doing work they find fulfilling and that starts with fixing how companies connect with the best talent.

About our founders: Edmund was a recruiter for 7 years, he placed engineer #1 at Brex and might be the only recruiter you’ve met who can code.

Li was the first employee at Vitable Health (YC S20), he has a pathological need to ship fast with exquisite design taste.

As our founding engineer you will take outsized ownership over entire products from scratch. We have early traction for an agent that actually gets work done. We're tackling an absurdly large and broken market. Apply for our job and help us fix recruitment so that no-one ever has to apply for a job again. What you’ll do Run multiple coding agents in parallel to ship delightful interfaces rapidly Use your knowledge of Typescript to review PRs from multiple agents and build scaffolding to improve their output Build robust infrastructure for domains that agents can't yet handle, integrating with a wide range of 3rd party systems Talk directly to customers, and push daily What we’re looking for You are super agent-pilled - you build (with) agents by default, are a macro-optimist about AI’s future capabilities and a micro-pessimist about the limitations today. You’ve got opinions about context engineering, memory and evals that are derived from hands on building not just reading Arvix. You prefer the pursuit of a singularly ambitious goal over incremental improvements to the status quo. We are not building a tool for recruiters, we are building an agent that outperforms all current human recruiters combined. We are obsessed with solving the whole problem not pieces of it. You’re curious - you believe rate of learning is what helps startups succeed in the 0→1 phase, not mindless thrash. We will win by having the highest fidelity mental model of our customers’ pain points. You’re high agency - you work without being told what to work on, pull on threads proactively and get frustrated when limited to very narrow parameters. Your agency and urgency pushes the company forward. You think from first principles - you reason over problems, avoid “happy ears” and don’t just replicate the status quo in code. You’re a futurist who is genuinely excited about seeing the brain computer interface, quantum computing, space exploration and androids in our lifetime. You are uniquely intense - you have a hobby that you do better than some professionals. Edmund will talk at you about the physics of pourover coffee, and Li is an interior designer at heart. We look forward to hearing you talk enthusiastically about your weird thing. Why join us work in-person out of the most curated and highly aesthetic startup hub in NYC (Betaworks). You’ll bump into the founders of FourSquare, teams building androids and hats that read your mind. join a team with domain taste. Edmund did the job we are replacing, and has earned insights into why recruitment is broken. We have the highest taste evals out there. take a massive swing at a market that will be insanely competitive and winner takes most, making Deel vs Rippling seem tame stay an absurdly lean team of builders. We are building the most talent dense, high leverage expedition crew. You will have all resources you need to do the best work of your life. We will never hire managers. build for builders. title: Senior Project Manager - SaaS Deployments
description_html:
The Senior Project Manager – SaaS Deployments is responsible for leading the successful implementation of AIO Logic’s enterprise SaaS platform for financial institution clients. This role owns the execution of end-to-end delivery across all phases of deployment, ensuring solutions are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with both client objectives and AIO Logic’s strategic goals.

Serving as a primary liaison between clients and internal teams, this role drives alignment, execution, and customer satisfaction for assigned client implementations throughout the deployment lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

·       Lead enterprise-level SaaS deployment projects from discovery and requirements gathering through configuration, testing, training, launch, and post-implementation stabilization

·       Own project planning, timelines, scope management, risk mitigation, and resource coordination for assigned client implementations

·       Partner closely with Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, and Client Success teams to ensure technical and business requirements are met

·       Facilitate clear, proactive communication with internal stakeholders and client executives

·       Monitor project performance metrics, dependencies, and risks to ensure delivery quality and predictability

·       Ensure client satisfaction by delivering solutions aligned to business outcomes and contractual commitments

·       Document lessons learned, develop reusable project artifacts, and contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives

Qualifications

·       Bachelor’s degree in business, Management, or related field; or equivalent work experience

·       8+ years of project or program management experience, with 4+ years leading complex enterprise SaaS or FinTech implementations.

·       Working knowledge of SaaS platforms, APIs, integration workflows, and data security considerations

·       Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams in fast-paced, client-facing environment

·       Strong ownership mindset with demonstrated delivery accountability

·       Proficiency in structured project management approaches (Agile, Hybrid, or AIO Logic’s Epsilon framework) and governance best practices.

·       Excellent client-facing, executive-level communication and facilitation skills

·       Consultative approach to stakeholder management

·       Experience using Jira, Asana, MS Project, or similar project management platforms

Preferred

·       Experience delivering SaaS solutions to financial institutions, including banks, credit unions, or specialty lenders.

·       Familiarity with financial services, asset-based lending, structured finance, or enterprise software deployments is strongly preferred.

·       PMP or equivalent certification preferred

·       Experience managing implementations involving third-party integrations, data providers, or core systems

·       Prior work in regulated environments (e.g., SOC 2, data privacy, security reviews, audit support)

·       Experience supporting enterprise or mid-market clients with complex stakeholder structures

Technical Skills

·       Ability to understand and translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders

·       Familiarity with: REST APIs and integration patterns, Data flows, file-based and API-based integrations, SaaS configuration, environments, and release cycles, 

Experience working alongside Engineering, QA, and DevOps teams during deployment and release activities,

·       Comfort reviewing technical documentation, implementation plans, and test scenarios

 Note: Deep engineering or hands-on development experience is not required.

 Core Competencies

·       Enterprise SaaS Delivery

·       Client & Stakeholder Management

·       Project Planning & Execution

·       Cross-Functional Leadership

·       Technical Acumen

·       Regulated Environment Awareness

·       Problem Solving & Decision Making

·       Process Improvement

·       Communication Excellence

·       Customer-Centric Execution

 

 

Equal Employment Opportunity & Compliance

·       AIO Logic, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

·       AIO Logic provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and to individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in accordance with applicable law.

·       This position is open to candidates authorized to work in the United States. AIO Logic does not currently offer visa sponsorship.

 Compensation Disclosure:

·       The salary range for this role is $125,000 – $145,000 USD, commensurate with experience, skills, and location. Salary ranges are provided in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

title: Business Development Manager
description_html:
HYBRID ROLE - Remote + 2-3 days a week in-office in Midtown NYC office. 

Independent Contributor Role - not a team manager. 

Salary Range: Base $70,000 - $85,000 depending on experience; possibility of OTE of up to $105,000

 

Are you inherently curious? Does the idea of addressing a prospect's needs and concerns with the right solution make you excited? Do you have the skills to build and develop trust with potential clients?

If this describes you, we invite you to apply! Come and be a part of the team that changes the way the world is rewarded at Virtual Incentives. From Fortune 100 companies to technology platforms, we work with some of the biggest brands in the world and support them globally. We are a successful software company with a start-up mentality.

Virtual Incentives was born from the idea that there is a better way for companies to deliver incentives. The belief that people matter is at the core of our culture.

VI is a fast-paced, high growth company with competitive benefits and compensation, with a human-first atmosphere.

 

Job description

As our newest Business Development Manager, you will directly contribute to business growth by working with prospective customers as the initial point of contact for Virtual Incentives.

You will be responsible for driving new leads through various outreach campaigns (email, LinkedIn, cold calls), as well as qualifying inbound leads and attending conferences. Using a marketing mindset, you’ll use a personalized approach to build relationships with leads.

Once the lead is qualified, you will  manage your deal pipeline and close new business opportunities. This role reports to our Vice President of Business Development.

Responsibilities:

  • Generate new leads through strategic communications and campaigns leading to consistently meeting/exceeding monthly lead goals
  • Qualify prospects to meet target client requirements
  • Manage a pipeline of prospects and move them through the sales funnel to closing
  • Report and manage client relationships using Salesforce and Hubspot

 

Key Attributes:

  • Inherently curious about how our prospect businesses work
  • Competitive spirit and drive for results
  • A sales mindset with excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly adaptable, fast learner
  • Action-oriented with strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Dependable, motivated, self-starter, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively
  • Ability to multi-task and remain productive in a hybrid work environment

 

Requirements:

  • 2-6 years of sales or business development experience
  • Personal discipline and self motivation; the initiative to work independently on sourcing new leads and opportunities
  • Ability to work collectively with a team on constructing solutions to meet client needs
  • Eagerness to learn, try new tactics and improve upon existing processes
  • Prior experience with Microsoft or Google Office
  • Bachelor's or Associate’s degree

Ideal Candidates also have:

  • Experience exceeding monthly lead sourcing or revenue targets is a plus
  • Experience using Google Office Suite
  • Experience using Salesforce

Job Type:

  • Full-time
  • Independent Contributor Role - not a team manager
  • Hybrid role - 2 -3 days per week from our NYC Midtown office space
  • Possibility for client-facing and conference travel

Local Metro Area Candidates Preferred.

Virtual Incentives provides exceptional benefits including medical, prescription, dental and vision coverage, life Insurance, retirement plans with company contribution, and flexible hybrid working environment.

Virtual Incentives is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. We are unable to provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, OPT or TN status) for this employment position. We are also unable to offer relocation for this position.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
description_html:
Tomorrow Lab is seeking a full-time permanent Level II or III Electrical Design Engineer to support their current tightknit design engineering team. Tomorrow Lab is looking for a self-motivated, detail oriented, creative individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys immediate impact from their work. 

Tomorrow Lab, a 15-year-old hardware innovation studio in Brooklyn, NY, collaborates with entrepreneurs and firms of all sizes to invent and prototype new technology products, transforming them into market-ready, manufacturable solutions. This role offers hands-on experience in hardware design and development, focusing on supporting the build and testing phases of prototypes under the team’s supervision. 


**to apply, please submit application directly through our website: www.tomorrow-lab.com/careers**

Role Responsibilities: 

The Electrical Design Engineer will design, develop, build and test electrical systems in order to produce prototypes for manufacturing for both Tomorrow Lab’s wide variety of clients and internal projects. The Electrical Design Engineer will primarily be a part of the firm’s EE department, however will also be responsible for working with and having awareness of other departments' workstreams within mechanical engineering, industrial design and supply chain. 

The Electrical Design Engineer  will work closely with Tomorrow Lab’s senior department engineers and senior leadership to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget and scope. 

The role will require great attention to detail, thorough documentation and frequent, consistent communication on task progress. Some examples of tasks assigned include, but are not limited to PCB design, PCB bring-up & troubleshooting, PCB reflow & soldering, EE to ME integration and testing with the corresponding documentation (analog, digital, RF, power). Above average communication skills are imperative, as it is critical for the individual in this role to deliver results based on process and documentation, and to always know where they are at in the duration of the task and scope of work at hand. 

Role Qualifications & Requirements: 

At least a BS or BE in Electrical Engineering or related Electronic Design field of study is preferred, but not required. 

A minimum of 3-5 years related experience is required. 

Experience in design, repair and analysis of electronic systems. 

Hardware experience is a plus. 

Proficiency in Eagle, Fusion, Arduino, Segger and STM32CubeIDE or equivalent. 

Must be comfortable writing firmware in C and C++ programming languages. 

Must be comfortable working on Mac and PC computers. 

Technical writing skills are a plus. 

Must be a self starter and able to work independently and on teams. 

Must have excellent time management skills in order to prioritize deliverables and timelines. 

Must be a clear communicator with excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

Should strive for excellence, find innovative solutions, be detail oriented and have an analytical mindset. 

All applicants must be able to provide a portfolio or detailed written explanation outlining their work, current and past, as well as their interests that relate to the role. 

At this time, all Engineering Staff must either be willing to relocate, or already reside in the NYC area. 

Non-US citizens are welcome to apply and will need to lead their own US Visa application process. 

Role Compensation & Benefits: 

Tomorrow Lab continually strives to be an Employer of Choice and works diligently to be both externally competitive and internally equitable in regards to compensation and total rewards. 

Salary range: $85,000.00 - $105,000.00 depending on experience and skill set. 

Comprehensive Health Benefits with National coverage including medical, dental and vision.

One Medical membership. 

Access to HSA and FSA’s. 

Basic, AD&D and voluntary Life Insurance offerings. 

Additional short & long term disability coverage to supplement State benefits. 

Admittance to Company Retirement Plan (for US Citizens & Greencard holders only). 

Maternity & Paternity leave with additional compensation to supplement State benefits (PFL). 

Generous PTO policies including vacation days, federal holidays & a winter break. 

Multiple Bonus Policies. 

Flexible & Hybrid working environment. 

Work from Home (WFH) annual stipend. 

Company wide events on a quarterly basis.

description_html:
Description and Requirements
The Team You Will Join
As a Regional Markets account executive, you'll play a critical role in supporting MetLife's growth. This team provides global benefits, sales, and solutions to U.S.-based employers with fewer than 5,000 employees-and with over 15,000 customers, it generates approximately $1.1 billion in annual sales and $4+ billion in revenue. Industry-wide, this $52 billion market typically grows 3-4%-but thanks to our exceptional team, MetLife consistently achieves 6-7% growth.
You'll help us maintain this momentum, working closely with advisors to small and regional businesses who want to expand their employee benefits. At the same time, you'll work collaboratively with various other departments, allowing you to explore new career possibilities and develop new strengths.
The Opportunity
  • Engage with advisors within a defined territory and find solutions that improve employers' insurance offerings-providing more people with quality insurance that works for them
  • Lead and assist in account management and creation
  • Build lasting relationships with local consultants and brokers to grow our book of business
  • Recognize occasions to upsell and offer new services to existing clients
  • Collaborate with colleagues on marketing, communication, and client services initiatives, developing new skills to complement
    your sales knowledge

About You:
You are a detail-oriented professional with a passion for people. You thrive on meaningful interactions with others, whether it's gaining a deeper understanding of challenges they're facing or working collaboratively to solve a problem. This affinity extends to your workplace community as well, and you strive to refine your skills while encouraging others.
Your previous sales experience has allowed you to hone your expertise, but you find yourself craving an atmosphere where you can broaden your horizons-maybe even make improvements that will impact your industry for years to come.
You're looking for MetLife. Here's what we're looking for from you:
What You Need to Succeed (Required Qualifications)
  • Experience in group benefit sales and/or after-sales service-with a proven track record of success
  • Valid Life & Health, or the ability to obtain within 3 months of hire.
  • Property & Casualty licenses, or the ability to obtain within six months of hire
  • Series 6 & 63 licenses, or the ability to obtain within one year of hire.
  • Stellar customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills-including public speaking, negotiating, influencing, and networking savvy
  • Finely tuned listening skills, complemented by a masterful talent for solving problems
  • Strategic and creative thinking skills
  • Keen financial acumen and attention to detail, particularly concerning product earnings
  • Motivated, independent, and adaptable working style, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced situations that require multitasking
    and prioritization
  • Accomplished change management leader, able to operate effectively in a highly matrixed environment
  • This role requires 25-50% local/market travel to engage with clients face-to-face!

The expected salary range for this position is $50,000. This role may also be eligible for incentive compensation under the sales plan for the position. All incentives and benefits are subject to the applicable plan terms.
Benefits We Offer
Our U.S. benefits address holistic well-being with programs for physical and mental health, financial wellness, and support for families. We offer a comprehensive health plan that includes medical/prescription drug and vision, dental insurance, and no-cost short- and long-term disability. We also provide company-paid life insurance and legal services, a retirement pension funded entirely by MetLife and 401(k) with employer matching, group discounts on voluntary insurance products including auto and home, pet, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance, as well as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and digital mental health programs, parental leave, volunteer time off, tuition assistance and much more!

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies", Fortune World's 25 Best Workplaces™, as well as the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world's leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.
Our purpose is simple - to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values - Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead - we're inspired to transform the next century in financial services. At MetLife, it's #AllTogetherPossible . Join us!
MetLife is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are made without regards to race, color, national origin, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, genetic information, citizenship status (although applicants and employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States), uniformed service member or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law ("protected characteristics").
If you need an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at accommodations@metlife.com. This information will be held in confidence and used only to determine an appropriate accommodation for the application process.
MetLife maintains a drug-free workplace.

title: Agent Product Manager
description_html:
🌿 Mission

The US healthcare system is complex, error-prone, and financially draining. Medical bills and insurance coverage shouldn’t be this hard to navigate. At Granted, we’re building the one solution every American can turn to for help.

Thanks to AI and new regulations, Granted can fight claim denials, correct billing errors, negotiate bills, and make coverage easier to understand—saving people time, money, and stress. Our goal is simple: to be the #1 platform that empowers all Americans to take charge of their healthcare

🏢 About Us

Founded by a former Oscar Health leader, we’re a seed-stage company with $17M in funding. We’re lucky to be backed by the founders and investors at Hugging Face, Rocket Money, Oscar Health, CaseText, Forerunner Ventures, RRE Ventures, and more. We are well-funded for the next few years.

🧭 About the Role

The Automations pod’s mission is to design, build, and operate agentic, end-to-end workflows that turn complex healthcare advocacy case work into reliable, scalable automations. This team owns the case pipeline from activation through resolution — increasing automation coverage, reducing cost to serve, and keeping experiences transparent by escalating to humans when needed.

As the PM for Automations, you’ll sit at the center of how we scale advocacy with speed, precision, and trust. You’ll work across engineering, SMEs, design and ops to transform messy, high-complexity healthcare workflows into structured, intelligent flows that feel effortless to users. Your work will directly shape how we deliver care and resolution at scale — making advocacy more automated, human when it matters, and dramatically more efficient.

🛠 What You’ll Do

  • Own the product strategy, KPIs and roadmap for the Automations pod.

  • Translate messy, multi-step operational workflows into agentic, intuitive product experiences.

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, SMEs and Ops to drive alignment on and deliver high-leverage automation opportunities.

  • Run your own processes to derive actionable user insights from both quantitative and qualitative data.

  • Define and run cross-functional processes to test, measure, learn and refine how agentic systems anticipate user needs.

  • Ship fast, reliable features that balance automation efficiency with user trust and transparency.

  • Establish success metrics that blend operational scale with human-centered experience.

🧰 You’ll Bring:

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years in product management roles within technical product environments.

  • Strong technical fluency - able to collaborate deeply with engineering.

  • Solid technical foundation (through education and/or hands-on experience).

  • Proven interest working with automation or agentic workflow products.

  • Comfort operating in 0→1, fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in healthcare or other complex regulated domains

  • Early-stage startup experience (Series B or earlier)

  • Background in AI / intelligent workflow products.

✨ You’ll Thrive Here If

  • You’re energized by chaos and the undefined — you love diving into ambiguous, complex problems, and spike on finding clarity fast.

  • You’re fluent working with deeply technical teams, but care just as much about creating beautiful, intuitive user experiences.

  • You are an excellent communicator and collaborator – you have proven experience clearly communicating high-level product vision and low-level requirements across cross-functional stakeholders.

  • You love turning messy, manual processes into clean, scalable systems that just work.

  • You see automation and agentic workflows not as bolt-ons, but as the foundation of a differentiated, user-first product.

This probably isn’t for you if…

  • You prefer clearly scoped work and get frustrated when priorities shift quickly.

  • You need a lot of process, layers of approval, or long timelines to do your best work.

  • You’re not excited by the idea of owning problems end to end in a small, high-trust team.

📢 You don’t need to check every single box—if you bring the right skills and drive, we want to hear from you! 📩

Granted is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us.

company_overview: Granted is the consumer-first, AI-native product that fights medical bills and helps people navigate health benefits.The U.S. healthcare system is confusing by design. Insurance coverage is opaque, benefits are hard to understand, and medical bills are often wrong. Nearly 40% of bills contain errors or are incorrectly denied, yet most people don’t have the time, expertise, or energy to challenge them or even know where to start. title: Director - Master Data Management (MDM) Modernization
description_html:
Description and Requirements
Role Value Proposition:
The position sits within the newly consolidated Data and Analytics (D&A) organization supporting the U.S. Business of MetLife. U.S. D&A assists all business lines of MetLife's U.S. business (about 2/3 of MetLife Global by earnings) with everything related to data, analytics and data science, from data infrastructure, data governance, data engineering, data modeling, data analysis to business intelligence, data science, and AI.
MetLife is seeking an experienced Sr. Leader to manage and oversee the modernization of MetLife's central Master Data Management (MDM) system, shaping and executing MetLife and DnA's MDM strategies. The MDM system connects to many source systems for all consumer touchpoints across all MetLife products and enables data for business and technology consumption to drive business goals.
This position will oversee all MDM modernization efforts for all the products and all D&A personnel working on this initiative. The role spans all relevant Data functions, from data infrastructure design and data engineering/MDM solution/modeling/analysis to reporting/dashboards and daily support for all deliverables. This position is crucial for a successful migration and modernization of the MDM solution, ensuring that the organization can leverage the benefits of cloud-based data management.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Strategic leadership: Build strategic partnerships with key business, Technology, and other leaders to create and define MDM modernization strategies and plans. Given the enterprise importance of MDM, the role is also a key Technology leader.
  • MDM Modernization: Partner with the BAU team and oversee the modernization and expansion of the current MDM infrastructure, pipelines, and logic.
  • Target State MDM architecture and solution: Responsible for defining, managing, and optimizing Master Data Management modernization delivery and solutions, including ingestion, curation, mastering data, and consumption, ensuring data integrity, quality, and availability across the organization.
  • Provide technical expertise and partner with the Architecture team in MDM architecture to ensure robust and scalable data solutions.
  • Develop/implement match/merge rules, survivorship logic, and data quality validations to ensure high data integrity by partnering with the on-prem team, Informatica, and other technology partners.
  • Collaborate with On-prem MDM team, business and technical teams to define data models, hierarchies, and governance workflows, and enable MDM capabilities.
  • Integrate MDM with upstream and downstream systems using Ingestion tools, ETL, cloud technologies, External data, APIs, and real-time services.
  • Data Migration: Migrating data from on-premises systems to cloud-based SaaS platforms and enable new capabilities, ensuring data consistency and integration across the products and LOBs.
  • Data Validation: Validating the data migration process and ensuring that the data loaded into the SaaS MDM solution is accurate and complete with no business impact.
  • Team Development & Cultural Transformation: Lead the cultural shift from a traditional technology-focused data team to a business-outcome-driven mindset.
  • Governance and data expertise: Establish governance frameworks for data modeling, metadata, data lineage, data quality, and related regulatory compliance.
  • Strong knowledge of the complete ILM life cycle, including documented requirements, data management, integration, storage & modelling, reporting, and analytic tools, and overall solutioning
  • Global team and resource management: Fully integrate a global team by balancing U.S. employees, India-based employees (both in multiple locations), and consulting resources. Drive consistent culture and performance standards to maximize effectiveness. Design career development paths for high-potential talent.

Essential Business Experience and Technical Skills:
Required:
  • Master's degree in computer science or a related quantitative field, or a B.S. degree with continuing education could be equivalent.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data and analytics leadership
  • 8+ years of experience with complex production MDM systems at a retail/consumer products company, including architecting, developing, and implementing match/merge rules, survivorship logic, consumption rules, and data quality validations to ensure high data availability and integrity to drive business values.
  • 5+ years of investment products experience, or other consumer financial services experience with similar complexity.
  • Extensive experience in Informatica on-prem and MDM Customer 360, demonstrating a deep understanding of Informatica MDM ecosystems.
  • Strong understanding of data management tools, processes, principles, practices, and cloud data solutions.
  • Expertise in data engineering, data governance, and Data management and related software and procedures. Proficiency in SQL.
  • Proven track record of leading analytics teams and delivering business value via creative data solutions while interacting with many stakeholders in a complex organization.
  • Excellence in stakeholder management and executive communication
  • Understanding of legacy insurance platforms and modernization initiatives

Preferred:
  • Expertise in Business Intelligence, including the creation and maintenance of custom, ad-hoc, and standard reporting packages. Proficiency in some related software packages (Tableau, Power BI, etc.)
  • Experience with Hadoop. Databricks and MS Azure are a plus.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA and other relevant consumer data regulations

At MetLife, we're leading the global transformation of an industry we've long defined. United in purpose, diverse in perspective, we're dedicated to making a difference in the lives of our customers.
Location Expectation: This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in office.
The expected salary range for this position is $140,000 - $180,000. This role may also be eligible for annual short-term incentive compensation. All incentives and benefits are subject to the applicable plan terms.
Benefits We Offer
Our U.S. benefits address holistic well-being with programs for physical and mental health, financial wellness, and support for families. We offer a comprehensive health plan that includes medical/prescription drug and vision, dental insurance, and no-cost short- and long-term disability. We also provide company-paid life insurance and legal services, a retirement pension funded entirely by MetLife and 401(k) with employer matching, group discounts on voluntary insurance products including auto and home, pet, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance, as well as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and digital mental health programs, parental leave, volunteer time off, tuition assistance and much more!

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies", Fortune World's 25 Best Workplaces™, as well as the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world's leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. title: Founding Account Executive
description_html:
Tracebit is helping some of the world’s best security teams at Snyk, Docker, Riot Games and many more to ‘assume breach’ at scale. Tracebit detects intrusions in cloud environments using canaries - decoy assets deployed to deceive attackers.

We're at a massive inflection point and there has never been a more exciting time to join us:

  • We are backed by some of the very best investors (Accel, Tapestry and more).

  • We are growing very quickly (we doubled ARR last quarter and will triple this year), having recently closed some incredible customers that we can’t disclose publicly!

  • We are one of the most exciting startups to be part of in the UK, have seen some great feedback from the market and are ready for explosive growth.

  • Regularly featured on top startup lists from industry veterans… Creandum’s Euro Seed top 50 list, Sifted’s 2025 London Startups To Watch, Notions Cloud Top 100, AlbionVC’s NHI Breakdown, MMCs Proactive Security Analysis, Accel’s Euroscape Top Startups 2024, etc.

  • Our research has recently helped fix a P1 security flaw in Google’s Gemini CLI.

  • We're Seed stage, and have grown the company from 2 to 14 people in 18 months,, with plans to triple this in the coming year.

We have strong traction in the US (80% of our customer base and forward-looking business). We've done this with a small team based in London. We've hit product-market fit and it's time to accelerate our growth by building our US sales team in New York.

Therefore, we are searching for a highly driven, emotionally intelligent and energetic individual to join Tracebit to help build our GTM practice from the ground up.

You will report to our Founding Sales Lead, who previously spent 5 years at Snyk as an early employee during a hyper-growth period from $18M to $300M ARR and 200 to 1,200 employees. You will also work closely with Tracebit's Co-Founders, CEO and CTO, who were both early employees at Tessian which was sold to Proofpoint in 2023.

This is a unique opportunity to join an early-stage, high-growth cybersecurity company, where you'll have real influence on our business growth with the opportunity to expedite your career as Tracebit grows.

About The Role:

As our first US-based Account Executives, you'll be instrumental in building our US GTM engine. You'll work closely with our London-based Founding Sales Lead to establish repeatable sales processes while closing your own deals.

What you'll do:

  • Close deals with some of the most exciting logos globally. You will own the full sales cycle from discovery through to contract signature on key deals into the $50-100k + ARR range, working across SMB and Mid-Market companies.

  • Work both inbound and outbound opportunities. Convert warm inbound leads from our growing user base and product-led motion. Run targeted outbound campaigns into accounts that match our ICP. You’ll own your own business.

  • Help build our sales playbook. We have GTM motions in place, but we want you to help re-write them. You will help to design a sales function - refining our discovery questions, demo flow, objection handling, and closing tactics.

  • Partner with the product and customer success teams. Provide feedback on what prospects share and what would accelerate deals. You’ll learn a lot about the product and help shape our roadmap based on market feedback.

  • Represent Tracebit at industry events. Attend key cybersecurity conferences (Black Hat, RSA, etc.) to build pipeline and strengthen relationships with prospects.

  • Operate with high velocity. You'll be managing multiple deals simultaneously, moving fast while maintaining deal quality. Expect to run many active opportunities.

This is a hands-on closing role in a fast-moving startup. You'll have autonomy to experiment, direct access to founders, and the opportunity to grow at a rapid place.

Who we're looking for:

  • You've sold technical products before. 3-5 years selling B2B SaaS, ideally in cybersecurity or developer tooling. You've closed deals in the $50K-100K+ range and know how to navigate technical buyers. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can hold your own in conversations with CISOs and security engineers.

  • You can own the full sales cycle. You've run deals from the first call to the signed contract. You know how to qualify, demo, handle objections, navigate procurement, and close. You're comfortable with both 30-day velocity deals and longer complex sales cycles.

  • You're a builder, not just an executor. You've ideally been an early sales hire before (or want to be). You're excited about figuring things out as you go rather than following a prescriptive playbook. You'll help refine our pitch, messaging, and sales process based on what you're learning in the field.

  • You're hungry and self-sufficient. You don't wait for leads to be handed to you. You're comfortable building your own pipeline, working inbound opportunities, and finding creative ways to get in front of the right people.

  • You thrive in startup environments. You're energized by fast iteration, ambiguity, and working closely with founders and product teams. You've experienced the pace of an early-stage company and know it's not for everyone.

  • The right characteristics. We think the Founding Account Executives at Tracebit will succeed by being highly emotionally intelligent, have great hunger and grit, demonstrate attention to detail and are hard-working, entrepreneurial individuals.

  • Bonus points if: You were among the first AEs at a startup and/or you've sold into security or technical teams.

FAQs

Where is the office?

We're setting up our New York office in Manhattan. You'll work closely with our London-based team and eventually other US-based team members as we grow.

Are you doing hybrid/remote?

Short answer: No, but flexible on a day-to-day basis.

Long answer: We are building the company on a foundation of office-based culture. We think we'll build the best company at the fastest pace while having a lot of fun by physically working together 5 days a week. On a case-by-case basis (leaving early for a holiday, staying home for a builder, working remote for a few days to visit family, etc.) we're very reasonable and flexible. We respect that this is not for everyone.

Can you sponsor visas?

We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.

title: Business Development Representative
description_html:
We are seeking a Business Development Representative (BDR) to help multi-location businesses transform their facilities management through our ACT Hub Platform. In this role, you will be on the front line of our growth efforts—identifying and engaging potential customers, qualifying leads, and helping build the pipeline for our sales team.

As part of a fast-growing company at the intersection of energy efficiency, technology, and building systems, you’ll have the opportunity to work directly with senior leadership and gain deep experience in B2B outreach, sales process development, and the facility optimization industry. Your primary focus will be to generate new business opportunities and open conversations with decision-makers across key commercial sectors.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct outbound prospecting through cold calls, email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, and social selling to generate new business opportunities
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads by understanding prospect needs, challenges, and objectives related to facilities management and energy efficiency
  • Research and identify target accounts across industries such as food service, retail, healthcare, senior living, automotive services, and hospitality
  • Collaborate with leadership to refine messaging, outreach cadences, and lead generation strategies
  • Schedule introductory meetings and demos between qualified prospects and senior sales team members
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of outreach activities, communications, and prospect statuses in the CRM (HubSpot or similar)
  • Support marketing campaigns by following up on inbound leads and event-driven opportunities
  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive offerings, and key market developments in facilities management, IoT, and energy technologies
  • Track and report on key activity metrics including call volume, email engagement, and lead conversion rates
  • Represent Actuate professionally in all external communications and interactions with potential clients

 

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in business development, sales, or related roles (SaaS, energy, or technology sectors preferred)
  • Proven success in outbound prospecting and lead qualification
  • Familiarity, or direct experience using AI powered tools for prospecting, and lead nurturing, and opportunity development  
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage decision-makers confidently via phone, email, and social channels
  • Experience using CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar) and familiarity with prospecting tools (ZoomInfo, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)
  • Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail in managing multiple accounts and outreach cadences
  • Self-motivated and persistent, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and exceed goals

title: Founding Account Executive
description_html:
Tracebit is helping some of the world’s best security teams at Snyk, Docker, Riot Games and many more to ‘assume breach’ at scale. Tracebit detects intrusions in cloud environments using canaries - decoy assets deployed to deceive attackers.

We're at a massive inflection point and there has never been a more exciting time to join us:

  • We are backed by some of the very best investors (Accel, Tapestry and more).
  • We are growing very quickly (we doubled ARR last quarter and will triple this year), having recently closed some incredible customers that we can’t disclose publicly!
  • We are one of the most exciting startups to be part of in the UK, have seen some great feedback from the market and are ready for explosive growth.
  • Regularly featured on top startup lists from industry veterans… Creandum’s Euro Seed top 50 list, Sifted’s 2025 London Startups To Watch, Notions Cloud Top 100, AlbionVC’s NHI Breakdown, MMCs Proactive Security Analysis, Accel’s Euroscape Top Startups 2024, etc.
  • Our research has recently helped fix a P1 security flaw in Google’s Gemini CLI.
  • We're Seed stage, and have grown the company from 2 to 14 people in 18 months,, with plans to triple this in the coming year.

We have strong traction in the US (80% of our customer base and forward-looking business). We've done this with a small team based in London. We've hit product-market fit and it's time to accelerate our growth by building our US sales team in New York.

Therefore, we are searching for a highly driven, emotionally intelligent and energetic individual to join Tracebit to help build our GTM practice from the ground up.

You will report to our Founding Sales Lead, who previously spent 5 years at Snyk as an early employee during a hyper-growth period from $18M to $300M ARR and 200 to 1,200 employees. You will also work closely with Tracebit's Co-Founders, CEO and CTO, who were both early employees at Tessian which was sold to Proofpoint in 2023.

This is a unique opportunity to join an early-stage, high-growth cybersecurity company, where you'll have real influence on our business growth with the opportunity to expedite your career as Tracebit grows.

About The Role:

As our first US-based Account Executives, you'll be instrumental in building our US GTM engine. You'll work closely with our London-based Founding Sales Lead to establish repeatable sales processes while closing your own deals.

What you'll do:

  • Close deals with some of the most exciting logos globally. You will own the full sales cycle from discovery through to contract signature on key deals into the $50-100k + ARR range, working across SMB and Mid-Market companies.
  • Work both inbound and outbound opportunities. Convert warm inbound leads from our growing user base and product-led motion. Run targeted outbound campaigns into accounts that match our ICP. You’ll own your own business.
  • Help build our sales playbook. We have GTM motions in place, but we want you to help re-write them. You will help to design a sales function - refining our discovery questions, demo flow, objection handling, and closing tactics.
  • Partner with the product and customer success teams. Provide feedback on what prospects share and what would accelerate deals. You’ll learn a lot about the product and help shape our roadmap based on market feedback.
  • Represent Tracebit at industry events. Attend key cybersecurity conferences (Black Hat, RSA, etc.) to build pipeline and strengthen relationships with prospects.
  • Operate with high velocity. You'll be managing multiple deals simultaneously, moving fast while maintaining deal quality. Expect to run many active opportunities.

This is a hands-on closing role in a fast-moving startup. You'll have autonomy to experiment, direct access to founders, and the opportunity to grow at a rapid place. 

Who we're looking for:

  • You've sold technical products before. 3-5 years selling B2B SaaS, ideally in cybersecurity or developer tooling. You've closed deals in the $50K-100K+ range and know how to navigate technical buyers. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can hold your own in conversations with CISOs and security engineers.
  • You can own the full sales cycle. You've run deals from the first call to the signed contract. You know how to qualify, demo, handle objections, navigate procurement, and close. You're comfortable with both 30-day velocity deals and longer complex sales cycles.
  • You're a builder, not just an executor. You've ideally been an early sales hire before (or want to be). You're excited about figuring things out as you go rather than following a prescriptive playbook. You'll help refine our pitch, messaging, and sales process based on what you're learning in the field.
  • You're hungry and self-sufficient. You don't wait for leads to be handed to you. You're comfortable building your own pipeline, working inbound opportunities, and finding creative ways to get in front of the right people.
  • You thrive in startup environments. You're energized by fast iteration, ambiguity, and working closely with founders and product teams. You've experienced the pace of an early-stage company and know it's not for everyone.
  • The right characteristics. We think the Founding Account Executives at Tracebit will succeed by being highly emotionally intelligent, have great hunger and grit, demonstrate attention to detail and are hard-working, entrepreneurial individuals.
  • Bonus points if: You were among the first AEs at a startup and/or you've sold into security or technical teams.


 

FAQs

Where is the office?

We're setting up our New York office in Manhattan. You'll work closely with our London-based team and eventually other US-based team members as we grow.

Are you doing hybrid/remote?

Short answer: No, but flexible on a day-to-day basis.

Long answer: We are building the company on a foundation of office-based culture. We think we'll build the best company at the fastest pace while having a lot of fun by physically working together 5 days a week. On a case-by-case basis (leaving early for a holiday, staying home for a builder, working remote for a few days to visit family, etc.) we're very reasonable and flexible. We respect that this is not for everyone.

Can you sponsor visas?

We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.

Location: Americas

Hi there!

We're looking for a Director of GTM Finance to partner with our sales and marketing teams as we scale. You'll help shape how we invest, where we grow, and how finance influences decisions across the business. If you love crunching numbers, in-depth financial analysis, and leading a cross-functional team, read on…

  • Our Commitment to Applicants

  • Culture and Values at Zapier

  • Zapier Guide to Remote Work

  • Zapier Code of Conduct

  • Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier


About You

  • You have 8-10+ years of experience in FP&A or strategic finance, ideally with an investment banking foundation early in your career.

  • You have experience at high-growth tech companies and have partnered closely with sales and/or marketing organizations to drive business outcomes.

  • You leverage GTM metrics (CAC, LTV, pipeline coverage, sales productivity, ARR/NRR) to identify opportunities, shape investment decisions, and influence strategy at the executive level.

  • You're a strong financial modeler who builds analyses that drive real decisions, not just reports.

  • You're a clear communicator who can translate complex financial insights into actionable recommendations for senior business leaders.

  • You have experience leading a team and care deeply about developing talent and building a strong team culture.

Things You'll Do

  • Partner with sales and marketing leadership to inform investment decisions and resource allocation, working at both the strategic level with executives and deeply with operators across the org.

  • Drive efficiency in customer acquisition by building analytical infrastructure to optimize LTV:CAC and marketing spend effectiveness.

  • Support sales growth targets through capacity planning, productivity analysis, and proactive identification of trends that inform org design and investment decisions.

  • Own performance reporting and forecasting for GTM, ensuring finance has a seat at the table when key decisions are made.

  • Lead and develop a strong team with opportunity for expansion as the function grows.

  • Position finance as a proactive business partner that shapes GTM strategy, not just tracks it.

How to Apply

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here.

description_html:
AI at Zapier

At Zapier, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.


Hi there!

Are you excited about scaling partner programs and turning partners into a powerful distribution channel? Join Zapier’s Partner Marketing team as our Partner Programs Marketing Manager and help shape how we engage with and grow our partner ecosystem.

In this role, you’ll lead the marketing of our integration and solution partner programs, create scalable enablement, and run multi-channel campaigns that drive partner-led growth. You’ll also design structured MDF programs and ensure our partners have the tools and resources to succeed.

Things You Will Do...

Partner program marketing and enablement

  • Drive the marketing-focused aspects of our integration and solution partner programs, ensuring partners are informed, engaged and see clear value in being a Zapier partner.

  • Manage fulfilment of partner perks and lifecycle communications, building engaging to partner strategies that keep partners informed and excited about Zapier.

  • Develop enablement resources like case studies, solution briefs, and playbooks to help partners successfully market Zapier’s solutions.

Partner campaigns and distribution

  • Create and deliver through-partner marketing playbooks and campaigns that partners can run to drive demand.

  • Provide partners with campaigns-in-a-box, messaging frameworks, and multi-channel assets to amplify Zapier’s reach.

  • Run webinars, co-marketing initiatives, and other campaigns through partners and track their effectiveness.

MDF Program Management

  • Design and manage a structured MDF program for solution and integration partners, defining eligibility, applications, and ROI measurement.

  • Support partner-led events and campaigns through MDF funding, ensuring these initiatives are repeatable and effective.

Partner acquisition and awareness

  • Drive awareness of our partner programs on key surfaces such as the website, partner portal and campaigns, in collaboration with PMM.

  • Support scaled partner acquisition by marketing our programs to prospective integration and solution partners.

  • Help grow adoption of partner solutions by highlighting partner offers, success stories and use cases to the right customer audiences.

Measurement and reporting

  • Define and track KPIs related to partner-influenced pipeline, partner engagement, campaign performance and program health.

  • Use data to refine segmentation, messaging, channels and offers across both to partner and through partner motions.

  • Provide regular insights on how partner programs and campaigns are contributing to Zapier’s growth.


About You...

Core Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in partner marketing or channel marketing in B2B SaaS.

  • Strong background in creating and managing multi-channel campaigns, for example webinars, email, content and co marketing initiatives.

  • Ability to create repeatable marketing programs that partners can use to effectively position and sell your company’s solutions

  • Experience building partner-facing enablement such as case studies, solution briefs, pitch decks and basic training materials.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence both partners and internal stakeholders.

  • Analytical mindset with experience setting KPIs, measuring performance and using insights to optimise programs and campaigns.

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Partner Management, Sales, Product Marketing & wider marketing teams

  • AI fluency. You have used AI tools for work or personal projects, or you are keen to dive in and learn fast. You look for ways to use AI to make programs more efficient, content creation faster and reporting easier.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with both technology partners and services or channel partners.

  • Familiarity with partner portals, MDF or partner fund programs, and CRM based partner tracking.

  • Interest in automation, integrations or AI tools and how customers use them.

How to Apply

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.
